result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=with, B=without): Both answers catch the same core problems: the 13px size, 1.2 line height, negative letter-spacing, full-width lines and tight spacing. Both give concrete fixes, including a centered ch-based column cap. B explains more fully, covering list-item spacing, the 16px floor and heading-spacing grouping, though it drifts by changing the font stack to system-ui. A keeps Arial and orders its fixes well, but it is a bit thinner and opens with 'four problems' before listing six. | pass 2 (A=without, B=with): Both answers diagnose the same problems: text that is too small, lines that are too tightly spaced, lines that are far too long, negative letter-spacing, tight paragraph and heading spacing, and heading sizes too close to the body text. Both give concrete replacement values. Answer A drifts into changing the typeface to system-ui and brings up font and color scales. Answer B keeps Arial, says which changes matter most and which to check first, and adds useful notes on rem units and wide tables and images.
